// CASE inorder_alias_without_reason_but_comment expect=fire
// type InOrderOptions = { reason: string };
type InOrderOptions = { label: string };
export async function inOrder<T>(
	items: Iterable<T>,
	step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
	options: InOrderOptions,
): Promise<void> {
	for (const item of items) {
		await step(item);
	}
}
